title: AMD RX5700 experiences special effects and excessive objects causing the computer to freeze in Godot 4.6+and above versions
body:
### Tested versions

The versions used when the problem occurred were 4.6.3 and 4.7.1
After switching to 4.5.2-stable, it became normal
Forward+

### System information

Windows 11 24H2 26100.4351 X64
AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor
AMD Radeon RX 5700
32.0 GB RAM

### Issue description

When I was creating a 3D scene for testing, I conducted a series of stylization tests. After adding enough effects, such as volume fog TAA、 Normal fog, dynamic light and shadow, etc. When entering F5 project testing, the entire screen will freeze, and after a period of time, it will recover and Godot will not respond. After adding more models, the situation will become more severe, and even black screens and screen rendering errors may occur.
There are also some stable freezing situations, which immediately freeze when I aim my gaze at the transparent glass (CollisionShape3D) or some semi transparent displays (Shelfslot) in the scene.
The following are some error logs,

```
ERROR: CreateResource failed with error 0x887a0005.
at: texture_create (drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:1432)

ERROR: Can't create buffer of size: 1441792, error 0x887a0005.
at: buffer_create (drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:969)

ERROR: Buffer argument is not a valid buffer of any type.
at: buffer_persistent_map_advance (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:804)

CrashHandlerException: Program crashed with signal 11
```

There is also a fault chain roughly as follows


Shadow secondary list exceeds 4096 entries
→ Attempt to expand to 8192 Persistent Buffer entries
→ Return 0x887A0005 (device removed)
Buffer creation failed, resulting in invalid RID
→ Buffer_persistent_map'advance() returns a null pointer
→ _fill_instance data() was written without checking for null pointers
→ 0xc000005 crash

When I tried to switch to version 4.5.2, everything went smoothly. After consulting with AI, I found that version 4.6 added something called Persistent Buffers. I guess it's because my graphics card's RDNA1 architecture is too old to keep up with this new feature.
[](url)
### Steps to reproduce

An AMD graphics card using RDNA 1 architecture?
Forward+
godot 4.6+
D3D12 (most prone to problems) or Vulkan
Create some transparent projects? And with a lot of visual effects added（uncertain）
My technical level is really poor

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godot_4.6_d3d12_freeze_mrp_2026-07-16_01-10-32.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30058566/godot_4.6_d3d12_freeze_mrp_2026-07-16_01-10-32.zip)
